cover.title: A <hl>Piece</hl> of Science
cover.sub: Practical guides for the curious engineer

k8s-airgap-ha.title: Kubernetes HA Air-Gapped Deployment
k8s-airgap-ha.desc: Deploy a 3+3 Kubernetes HA cluster on air-gapped infrastructure — Nexus 3 registry, DNS, NTP, Flannel, MetalLB, NGINX Ingress. Fully isolated.

linux-admin.title: Linux Administration
linux-admin.desc: From terminal commands to server management — everything a sysadmin needs in one guide.

openshift-upi-v414.title: OpenShift 4.14 UPI on vSphere
openshift-upi-v414.desc: Deploy OpenShift 4.14 on vSphere using User Provisioned Infrastructure — HAProxy, NFS, govc, from VMs to production cluster.

storage-iscsi-3lun.title: 3-LUN iSCSI Storage Configuration
storage-iscsi-3lun.desc: Configure a Dell EMC ME4024 array and three RHEL 9 nodes — iSCSI, MPIO, LVM, XFS, Kubernetes integration, and DR procedures.

github-actions.title: GitHub Actions Guide
github-actions.desc: From zero to CI/CD — workflows, YAML structure, matrix builds, reusable workflows, security, and interview questions.

bash-basics.title: Bash Scripting Basics
bash-basics.desc: A quick reference for the most common Bash patterns — conditionals, loops, and functions with copy-paste ready scripts.
